document.title: Rules of Procedure for Obtaining Full Membership of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation
document.purpose: Defines the eligibility requirements, application procedure, review process, approval process, and activation of full membership in the OIC.

SecretaryGeneral.role: Receives applications, informs Member States, provides opinion

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Applicant must be a member of the United Nations.
Applicant must have a Muslim majority population.

eligibility.approval_method: Consensus of the Council of Foreign Ministers

submission.minimum_notice: 90 days before the ordinary session of the Council of Foreign Ministers

must_include: Applicant wishes to become a full member.
Applicant agrees to abide by the objectives of the OIC Charter.
Applicant agrees to follow the principles of the OIC Charter.
Applicant agrees to fulfill all obligations of the OIC Charter.

required_information.description: Percentage of Muslims compared to the total population.
Ratio of Muslims compared to followers of other religions.
Information about Muslim communities living under the applicant state's jurisdiction.
Information showing that Muslim communities enjoy equal rights under national laws.
Applicant must not have been condemned by an OIC Resolution because of policies or practices toward Muslim communities.

after_receiving_application.action: Inform all Member States within 30 days.
Provide the General Secretariat's opinion regarding the application.

council_review.meeting: Ordinary Session of the Council of Foreign Ministers

late_submission_rule.condition: Application submitted less than 90 days before the session.
late_submission_rule.result: Application is postponed to the next ordinary session.

membership_activation.effective_date: Date when the Instrument of Ratification of the OIC Charter is deposited with the General Secretariat.
membership_activation.result: Applicant immediately becomes entitled to exercise OIC membership rights.

exceptions.rule: Existing Member States are not affected by these Rules of Procedure.

entry_into_force.condition: Rules become effective immediately after approval by the Council of Foreign Ministers.

step_2.action: Attach all required declarations and supporting information.

step_3.action: Submit application at least 90 days before the Council meeting.

step_5.action: Notify Member States within 30 days and provide an opinion.

step_6.action: Review the application during the ordinary session.

step_7.action: Approve only if consensus is reached.

Submitted 90 Days Before Session?.No: Move application to next ordinary Council session

important_deadlines.member_state_notification: Within 30 days after application is received
